answer: SELECT AVG(u.UpVotes) AS avg_upvotes, AVG(u.Age) AS avg_age FROM users u JOIN (SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(Id) AS cnt FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(Id) > 10) p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId;

SELECT c.Text FROM comments c WHERE c.UserId IN (SELECT UserId FROM postHistory WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'));
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT ExcerptPostId, WikiPostId FROM tags WHERE TagName = 'sample';
SELECT COUNT(pl.Id) * 1.0 / 12 AS avg_monthly_links FROM postLinks pl JOIN posts p ON pl.PostId = p.Id WHERE strftime('%Y', pl.CreationDate) = '2010' AND p.AnswerCount <= 2;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS num_users FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.Location = 'United Kingdom' AND p.FavoriteCount >= 4;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS pct_above_50 FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini';
SELECT u.DisplayName FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';
SELECT p.FavoriteCount FROM posts p JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id WHERE c.UserId = 3025 AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39.0';
